name: io.github.cyanheads/pixoo-mcp-server
description: Render and push styled pixel art, text, dashboards, and animations to Divoom Pixoo LED displays.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_IP
environmentVariables.description: Device IP address on the local network (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Required for device tools; discovery and pure-render (push: false) work without it.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Display size in pixels: 16, 32, or 64. Must match the physical device.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for auto-saving preview PNG and GIF files. When unset, previews are returned in-response only.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_PUSH_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum interval between device pushes in milliseconds. Prevents device freeze from rapid-fire commands.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_SERVE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host advertised in the URL the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for NAT or a DNS name. When unset, the local address the OS routes to PIXOO_IP; the listener binds that address either way.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_SERVE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the listener the device downloads an animation of more than 40 frames from, for firewall rules. When unset, a free port.

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Browser executable for HTML rendering, such as the chrome-headless-shell that `npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome-headless-shell@stable --path <dir>` installs. When set, the only browser tried: a path that is not an executable file fails rather than falling back. When unset, the newest chrome-headless-shell in Puppeteer's cache (~/.cache/puppeteer).

environmentVariables.name: PIXOO_HTML_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Offer pixoo_render_html. false (or 0, no, off) disables it, removing it from tools/list; unset or true keeps it. A value that is not one of those boolean spellings fails startup.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
